agent.f.family.buddy.title: Backup buddy
agent.f.family.buddy.sub: Back each other up with a second TitanOS
agent.f.family.buddy.intro: Two TitanOS back each other up, encrypted with the sender's key: the partner cannot read anything. The partner reaches this NAS over Tailscale.
agent.f.family.buddy.address: Address of this NAS for the partner
agent.f.family.buddy.addressHint: Tailscale address or name, e.g. nas-eva.tail1234.ts.net. Partners reach this NAS on port 8752 (firewall service "Backup-Buddy").
agent.f.family.buddy.volumeHint: Kept under .titanos/buddy/<partner>; each partner gets its quota.
agent.f.family.buddy.protectHint: What partners delete here stays in quarantine for this many days and can be brought back, even if a partner was taken over.
agent.f.family.buddy.problem.volume: No volume for the partners' backups is mounted.
agent.f.family.buddy.problem.address: The address of this NAS is not set; without it no partner can pair.
agent.f.family.buddy.problem.tailscale: Tailscale is not connected; partners cannot reach this NAS right now.
agent.f.family.buddy.noJob: nothing chosen to back up yet
agent.f.family.buddy.probeNone: None yet; runs after the next backup
agent.f.family.buddy.codeHint: Enter this code on the other TitanOS (valid for 10 minutes):
agent.f.family.buddy.mine: What I back up at the partner
agent.f.family.buddy.enterHint: Or enter the code of the other TitanOS here:
agent.f.family.buddy.footer: Backups are made with restic and a password only this NAS knows. Nothing is overwritten at the partner; deleted data stays in quarantine for {days} days.
agent.f.family.buddy.endText: The schedule to {name} ends and {name} can no longer store anything here. What this NAS backed up at {name} stays there until {name} deletes it.
agent.f.family.buddy.endData: Also delete the backups of {name} on this NAS
agent.f.family.catalog.title: Skill catalog
agent.f.family.catalog.sub: Skills from the community app store
agent.f.family.catalog.intro: The skills come from the app store sources: the folder skills/ in TitanOS-Apps and in own sources. They are loaded like the apps, after the start and once a day. You see the whole content before installing.
agent.f.family.catalog.lead: Skills of other TitanOS users from the app store sources. You see the whole content before installing.
agent.f.family.catalog.empty: The app store sources hold no skills yet.
agent.f.family.catalog.unknown: This account does not have these tools: {tools}. It cannot be installed.
agent.f.family.catalog.secret: The skill contains something that looks like a password or key; it cannot be installed.
agent.f.family.catalog.askHint: The skill itself changes nothing. Tools that change something ask first as always.
agent.f.family.catalog.shareHint: Downloads a skill as a package to submit as skills/<name>/skill.yaml to TitanOS-Apps or an own source.
agent.f.family.buddy.jobError: Paired, but the backup job could not be saved: {error}
agent.f.family.catalog.offHint: Owners and administrators switch it on.
